dynamic.title: QR with expiry and revocation
dynamic.noExpiryHint: Leave empty for no expiry. The time is converted to UTC before sending.
dynamic.notice: Dynamic QR needs a server for redirects and expiry. The server stores the destination, creation/expiry/revocation times and a management-key hash; no photos or documents. Records remain until an operator removes them. Revocation stops redirects without deleting the record.
dynamic.consent: I agree to store the destination and information above to create a dynamic QR.
dynamic.empty: Enter a destination and create a code to preview it.
dynamic.needsNetwork: Scanning requires a network connection. Share this code only with intended recipients.
dynamic.keyNotice: The revocation key is returned only once and stays in this session by default. Download a receipt or explicitly save on this device. This tool cannot revoke a code without its key.
dynamic.active: Receipt: not revoked from this session
dynamic.loadSaved: Open codes saved on this device
dynamic.noSaved: No codes saved on this device.
dynamic.saveDevice: Save codes and management keys on this device
dynamic.revokeConfirm: Revoke this code? Revoked codes cannot be reactivated.
dynamic.forgetHint: Forgetting removes the device copy; it does not revoke the server code.
dynamic.failed: Creation failed. Your input is retained; check the network before retrying.
dynamic.invalid: Use a public HTTPS URL without credentials and a future expiry.
dynamic.rateLimit: Hourly QR creation limit reached. Try again later.
dynamic.revokeFailed: Revocation failed. Check the network and receipt before retrying.
dynamic.storageFailed: Could not save on this device. Download a receipt to retain the key.
dynamic.receiptInvalid: Invalid receipt or larger than 16 KB.

labels.title: Label contents
labels.notice: One code per line. CSV uses the first column; skipping the header is your choice. Up to 500 labels including copies. Data and PDF remain on device.
labels.printHint: Print at 100% / actual size, without fit-to-page. Test scan one label before printing a batch. Bars are not squeezed; increase the label size if a code does not fit.
labels.invalid: Labels must fit A4; margins 5–20 mm, gaps 0–10 mm and no more than 500 total labels.
labels.codeInvalid: Invalid code, dense QR or barcode does not fit. Check each value or increase label dimensions.
labels.fileInvalid: Could not read file or larger than 1 MB.
labels.changed: {{total}} values normalized (uppercase / check digit). Review before printing.
